title: Inside PostgreSQL
brief: Trace one connection and request through PostgreSQL processes, shared buffers, heap tuples and indexes. Explain tuple visibility, HOT updates and their physical limits so native plans and maintenance have a concrete physical setting.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns retained horizons and transaction-age maintenance.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-wal: Owns durability controls and crash drills.

title: PostgreSQL JSON and structured alternatives
brief: Choose columns, related rows or JSONB from the facts, validation and update boundary. Match native JSON operators and indexes while preserving established identities, types and data rules.

neighbouring_ownership.data-modelling: Owns introductory JSON versus tables versus EAV judgement.
neighbouring_ownership.values: Owns general equality and value representation.

title: PostgreSQL schema changes under load
topic: PostgreSQL live schema and index work
brief: Choose native schema and index operations from their lock, rewrite and validity behaviour. Bound waits, validate backfill convergence and maintain indexes without accepting incomplete semantic or physical work.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-indexes: Owns which access method serves the query.

title: Full-text search in PostgreSQL
brief: Build text retrieval from tokens, phrases and configuration through ranked, filtered results. Keep indexed candidate retrieval, linguistic matching and relevance evaluation distinct, including maintenance when source text or configuration changes.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vector: Owns embedding-vector retrieval; text relevance is not nearest-neighbour recall.

title: Vector search in PostgreSQL
brief: Evaluate vector retrieval independently from the embedding model’s semantic usefulness. Compare exact, HNSW and IVFFlat retrieval under filtering, nearest-neighbour recall, latency and index lifecycle costs.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-text: Owns linguistic matching and lexical ranking.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-extensions: Owns shared installation, restore and upgrade dependency handling.

title: Types and extensions in PostgreSQL
topic: PostgreSQL specialised types and extension lifecycle
brief: Express overlap and spatial predicates with suitable types, operators and indexes. Own extension installation, privileges, dependencies, restore, upgrade and removal, including when an extension becomes part of the application’s durability contract.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vector: Owns complete vector retrieval and evaluation.
